(
Posting a video
Under review, not yet approved. Phone and desktop.
A video always uses a song and lasts 3 to 15 seconds. The steps are Song, Start, the camera, Review. There is no caption, cover or 18+ control, per the workspace_owner.
Start: the bracket is the 15 seconds and never changes size. The author drags the song under it and hears it from there. Recording stops when the bracket ends, or sooner if the author stops; a 9-second take uses 9 seconds of song.
The camera is the one screen outside the page structure on phone: full-bleed, close at the top left, the song in a pill, the record button, Upload on the left. Review is full screen.
On desktop the same four steps are cards in the main column, like the song flow (above the phone screens). The camera is the computer's webcam in the same 9:16 frame, with Upload and Flip under it; that is my proposal, since the code's camera is built for phones.
After Post the upload shows on this screen, then the composer closes and the author lands on the community page they posted in, per the workspace_owner. The ratified Spec 024 says Home, so it needs amending. The video appears in that feed once it is ready. There are no processing or published screens (Spec 024: no drafts, no status pages), and a failure or a guideline block arrives as a notification (Screens/Shell/Notifications).
"Use this song" on a song post opens this same flow at Start with that song already chosen, and posts to the song's own community, so there is no destination page. It is not shown to someone who cannot post in that community. This is my proposal; the code asks for a destination today.
This flow only posts a public video. Dancing for a reward is a separate flow (Flows/Dance/Take).
Design changes from the code, not yet approved:
1. Choosing a song is tap a row, then Next. The code has a Use button on the row.
2. The start point is its own step, with the waveform bracket. The code has a slider on the song screen.
3. The camera shows the time left and a Flip button. The code uses the front camera only and shows no time.
4. The buttons read Next and Post, not "Continue to video" and "Publish video".
Not drawn yet: the song and camera failure states, and recording and uploading on desktop (they match the phone).
Source: features/posts/video-submission; specs 013 and 024.
Desktop: the same steps as cards in the main column, in order. Under review, not yet approved.
